# Filter slot role

<!-- Generated by `loom modules --markdown` from the role descriptor. -->

Shapes the spectrum of a signal around a cutoff frequency.

ID `loom.role.filter` · Version 1

## Inputs

| Port | Signal | Requirement | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| In (`in`) | audio | Required | The audio to filter. |
| Cutoff (`cutoff`) | pitch | Optional | Moves the cutoff as pitch: +0.1 doubles it. |

## Outputs

| Port | Signal | Requirement | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Out (`out`) | audio | Required | The filtered audio. |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Unit | Values | Requirement | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cutoff (`cutoff`) | Hz | Continuous | Required | The frequency where the filter starts to cut. |
| Resonance (`resonance`) |  | Continuous | Optional | Boosts the frequencies near the cutoff. |
| Drive (`drive`) |  | Continuous | Optional | Raises the input level so the filter saturates. |

## Modules that fill this role

- [Ladder](loom.filter.ladder.md)
- [One-Pole](loom.filter.onepole.md)
- [SVF](loom.filter.svf.md)
